points.description: Paper title, authors, arXiv, OpenReview, and collection anchor are pinned.
Audit and latest paper-version references are documented.
The official author-code link and independent-audit boundary are recorded.
The C1 finite consistency proxy has a committed producer and result.
The C2 selected-case certificate and its limitations are committed.
The C3 selected-case ESS certificate and its limitations are committed.
The C4 finite variance-reduction proxy and its baseline boundary are committed.
The C5 finite tracking proxy and its single-instance boundary are committed.
The C6 MNIST experiment is explicitly recorded as not reproduced.
The historical run log and conservative gate agree with the six-claim record.
General SMC propagation, resampling, EBM, ImpDiff, and 2D benchmark evidence is not available.
MNIST EBM kernel-mismatch and reward-tuning evidence is not available.
